notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Platte River Rodeo in Saratoga, 307-326-8855, with a note that the first organization called was not involved and had no information; an alternate number 307-710-7630 and platteriverrodeo@gmail.com are listed, and a June 2 call left a message. Gmail confirms prior Adventure Zone outreach. Source: handwritten call notes, page 84; Adventure Zone Gmail.
